description: This file is a script written in JavaScript (using ECMAScript modules) that generates plugin SDK facade files for a project. It includes functions for parsing command-line arguments, generating output modules based on imported data, and managing the flow of writing or checking generated files. The script references various internal modules for formatting, output utilities, and plugin facade data structures.

methods.name: parseArgs
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to determine whether to check or write generated files.

methods.name: generatePluginSdkFacades
methods.description: Generates and writes (or checks) plugin SDK facade modules based on provided parameters.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main asynchronous function that orchestrates the generation process based on command-line arguments.
